title: The Breadth Illusion: Mega Earnings & Rebalance Loom
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Weak breadth reflects rotation out of defensives (XLP, energy, utilities) into tech/semis, not broad risk-off.
10y nearly hit 5.30%; a real concern (equity risk premium) and driver of utilities weakness.
Funds selling IGV/software and buying semis into the rebalance; Micron earnings and NFP add positioning risk.

calls.condition: Breadth at ~6.5th percentile (red signal) historically marks bottoms, but not all clear; could get worse before better and may retest.
calls.reason: Proprietary breadth percentile, S5FD/S5FI in oversold zone (usually a bounce within ~30 days), extreme S5FI/NDFI rotation historically marks bottoms.
calls.quote: usually within 30 days, we have some semblance of a bottom or some semblance, I should say it this way, of a bounce.

calls.reason: Tactical semiconductor breadth model triggered long; semi breadth improving; funds rotating from IGV into semis (semicap bottom-fishing) for the rebalance.
calls.quote: We're going long semis. We want long semis here and it worked out exceptionally well. The breath of semiconductors is actually getting better.

calls.reason: IGV/SOX ratio double top and breaking down; funds selling software into the rebalance; IGV could not get over the prior Friday level.
calls.quote: So this tells me very clearly that they're favoring semis over IGV tomorrow.

calls.condition: Unless earnings show missed gross margins / negative call; if it dips Thursday, expects institutions to buy. A clean blowout could move more than the ~90-point implied move.
calls.reason: Goldman and Wedbush raised numbers; funds likely buy semis on any dip after window-dressing constraints.
calls.quote: I think they buy semis on the dip if you come down on Thursday

calls.reason: Utilities fell inversely to 10y yield but are now holding critical levels; bought names two days ago at a perceived bottom.
calls.quote: we actually bought some of these names two days ago when we saw a bottom.

calls.reason: Risk-on appetite: IBB and genomics being bought on pullbacks; Twist and Tempus new highs, Moderna breaking out (held in community).
calls.quote: You are seeing IBB bought left and right. You are seeing genomics bought left and right hitting new highs.
